You stand in a garden at the foot of the tower with the height bar at zero.
Wide, easy ledges teach the jump: tap for a hop, hold for a full jump.
At about 15 metres the ledges narrow and you miss one, fall, and land a few ledges down instead of dying.
You climb back past it, reach the first gold rest floor at 30 metres, a chime plays and a banner shows the height.
Above it the first moving platform slides into view.
*(provisional)* Real trouble starts in the second zone, around minute three: narrow ledges, then moving platforms.
Nothing kills you; a miss costs height, from a few metres to a whole zone, and gold rest floors every 30 metres or so catch long falls.
Each of the ten zones adds one thing: crumbling ledges, ice, wind, bouncers, conveyor belts, red bumpers that knock you off, and a final zone that mixes them.
A first clear should take most players an hour or more; a practised run about ten minutes.
